ops.title: Carry Trunk credentials through the existing new-worker secret pipe
ops.description: Owner: /root/agent_queue_tooling. Proposal pinned to cc-remote main d0a603113713f72a4c786550571e920a3a7c5fec. Extend only the existing named secret slot and one-use SSH FIFO protocol; fetch the existing scoped shared key locally through standing SSM access and expose it only to the newly launched worker as TRUNK_MERGE_API_KEY. Proposal artifact: /tmp/trunk-native-stacks-nexkvlfo/sprite-trunk-auth-plan.json. No existing-worker changes, regular secret files, image keys, AWS cache copies, or role grants.

ops.text: Root and independent security review approve the concrete source contract before implementation.
Current-head source CI proves optional/present/stale/failing Trunk delivery, secret-free diagnostics and metadata, FIFO deletion, and unchanged author/model/GH behavior.
Official cc-remote and corrected ccx releases are pinned from actual immutable artifacts; the genuine remote payload build is uploaded and accepted with matching manifests and inventory.
A newly prepared worker proves native stack selection and scoped Trunk reads without copied AWS caches, persistent secret files, or changes to existing workers.
